lines.text: Hi, I'm Sindy! Welcome to sind, Slurm in Docker, and to your first cluster.
Want to try Slurm, but there's no cluster at hand? Let's build a complete one on your own machine. All you need is Docker and sind.
With one command, sind sets up the network, DNS and SSH, generates the munge key and Slurm configuration, and starts every node as a container.
Let's try it! Run sind create cluster, no arguments needed. Out comes a cluster called default: one controller, one worker.
No news is good news: sind prints nothing on success. Now, sind get clusters shows it up and running.
One level deeper, sind get nodes shows the container behind each node, with its DNS name and IP address.
To recap: one command builds the cluster, no output means it worked, and sind get shows what's running.
Your cluster is ready for jobs! Next up: cluster configuration. See you there!
